candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, causing order to fail and gateway checkout to return 502.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment metrics show zero counts for both 200 and 503 on /v1/authorizations, so the 503 is only established by traces; payment-side logs were excluded.

report.explanation: Traces show every checkout failing at payment POST /v1/authorizations with 503, propagating to order 502 and gateway 502; inventory reservations succeed. Payment-side metrics are empty/zero, so the failure mechanism is unconfirmed.
missing_evidence: Payment service logs and dependency metrics to confirm why /v1/authorizations returns 503
Payment readiness/health status at incident time
